title: Add post-init instructions output in rocket init
description: After creating the .agent/ structure, print styled next-step instructions using the Rocket color palette.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket init prints '📝 Edit .agent/prd/PRD.md' after creation
rocket init prints '📋 Edit .agent/tasks.json' after creation
rocket init prints '▶ Then run: rocket loop' after creation
Instructions use appropriate colors from the Rocket palette

steps.details: After success message in initCommand, add: console.log('\nNext steps:'); console.log('  📝 Edit .agent/prd/PRD.md with your project requirements'); console.log('  📋 Edit .agent/tasks.json with your task list'); console.log('  ▶ Then run: rocket loop')

steps.description: Use ANSI color codes for the command suggestion
steps.details: Highlight 'rocket loop' in cyan: `console.log('  ▶ Then run: \x1b[36mrocket loop\x1b[0m')`
